Hi Alex / Priya —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery so we have alignment and clear next steps: 

What we heard
- Priority: bring LLM-powered summaries and assisted underwriting into your core product this Q1, with strict data residency and audit requirements.
- Constraints: must be deployed inside your VPC or via an on‑prem option for regulated customers; SOC 2 and KMS integration required.
- Scale target: steady throughput with occasional spikes during batch reprocessing (expect ~10–20k tokens/min initially).

Redwood options that map here
- Redwood Private (VPC / on‑prem): fits data residency + KMS requirements.
- Redwood Dedicated: reserved capacity in our managed infra if VPC not required for certain workloads.

Requested next steps
1) Technical deep-dive with Laura (solutions engineer) to validate network/firewall requirements and deployment flow.
2) Security pack (SOC 2 summary, data flow diagram) — attached datasheet has high‑level details.
3) Provisional SOW + ballpark pricing for both Dedicated and Private options.

If that looks right, can we lock a 60-minute deep‑dive next week? Laura is available Tue/Wed (11/11–11/12) afternoon PST.

Attaching: redwood_private_datasheet.pdf (high-level architecture + compliance notes).

Best,
